dialog.english:
We made it to Vamdemon's castle,
but it's gonna be hard to get us
all in there.
dialog.translation:
Hemos llegado al castillo de
Myotismon, pero será difícil que
entremos todos ahí.

dialog.english:
It doesn't seem like we'll be able
to sneak in without being noticed.
dialog.translation:
No parece que podamos colarnos
sin que nos vean.

dialog.english: So then what are we gonna do?
Leave it to me!
Agumon...

The castle's full of Digimon, so I
can sneak in if I go by myself!
dialog.translation:
Hay Digimon por todo el castillo,
así que puedo colarme yo solo!

dialog.english:
If we can infiltrate Vamdemon's
army, it may work out!
dialog.translation:
Si nos infiltramos en su
ejército, podría funcionar!

dialog.english:
I'm worried about Agumon going in
there alone, so I'm going in, too!
dialog.translation:
Me preocupa que Agumon entre
solo ahí, así que yo también voy!

dialog.english: Are they gonna be okay?

Leave it to me! I may not look the
part, but I'm pretty confident in
my acting skills!
dialog.translation:
Dejádmelo a mí! No lo parezco,
pero se me da genial actuar!

dialog.english:
Got it! If you find someplace you
think we can sneak in through,
come back here!
dialog.translation:
Entendido! Si encontráis un sitio
por donde colarnos, volved
aquí!

dialog.english: Okay! Wait for us!
Are they gonna be okay?
Recruiting Soldiers

I don't know how many they must
have gathered by now, but it's
better to be safe than sorry.
dialog.translation:
No sé cuántos habrán reunido
ya, pero más vale prevenir
que curar.

dialog.english:
*sigh* They're a bunch of useless
grunts.

No need to worry! I'll train 'em
real hard!
dialog.translation:
Tranquilo! Los entrenaré a
base de bien!

dialog.english:
I'm counting on you. Considering
your experience, you're the only
suitable teacher around here.
dialog.translation:
Cuento contigo. Con tu
experiencia, eres el único
profesor adecuado por aquí.

dialog.english: Indeed!

All right then, I'll leave them in
your hands!
dialog.translation:
Muy bien, entonces los dejo
en tus manos!

dialog.english:
Hey, is it true you're recruiting
soldiers?
dialog.translation:
Oye, es verdad que buscáis
soldados?

dialog.english: Can we join?

Hmm. They might be better than
this lot. Okay, get over here!
dialog.translation:
Hmm. Puede que seáis mejores
que estos. Vale, venid aquí!

dialog.english:
Okay, fresh meat, first you'll be
running 100 laps! After that, 500
bunny hops!
dialog.translation:
Bien, carne fresca, primero
daréis 100 vueltas! Después,
500 saltos de rana!

dialog.english: What are we gonna do....

At this rate, it desn't look like
we'll have a chance to get the
others inside.
dialog.translation:
Así, no parece que vayamos a
tener ocasión de meter a los
otros dentro.

dialog.english:
We have to do something about
Nanimon.
dialog.translation:
Tenemos que hacer algo con
Nanimon.

dialog.english:
Hey, I was in a unit with him
once.
dialog.translation:
Oye, yo estuve en su unidad
una vez.

dialog.english: ...Tell us more.

He kept getting drunk off alcohol,
so he was completely useless in
real combat.
dialog.translation:
Siempre estaba borracho, así
que era un inútil total en
combate real.

dialog.english: So he's a heavy drinker.
That might be what we need!

Lord Vamdemon, I am pleased to
report that we have gathered a
multitude of soldiers.
dialog.translation:
Amo Myotismon, me complace
informar de que hemos reunido
a multitud de soldados.

dialog.english: Are they of use to us?
P-Probably...
Ahahaha...

Can you even call them soldiers?
Are you trying to make a B-team or
something?
dialog.translation:
Se les puede llamar soldados?
Estáis montando un equipo de
segunda o qué?

dialog.english:
Ugh, if you keep talking like
that, I'm gonna...
dialog.translation:
Uf, como sigas hablando así,
voy a...

dialog.english: What? You wanna go?

Stop. Anyway, Tailmon, did you
find anyone useful?
dialog.translation:
Basta. Bueno, Gatomon,
encontraste a alguien útil?

dialog.english:
Yes, as instructed. I've traveled
around and scouted a number of
respected veterans.
dialog.translation:
Sí, tal y como se me ordenó.
He viajado y reclutado a varios
veteranos respetados.

dialog.english: I look forward to meeting them.
Yes, sir!
Hahaha!
Are they still in there?!
I'm getting impatient.
Hm?
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Palmon! You made it!
You did it!
Just a second! Poison Ivy!

Grab onto the vines and get in
here!
dialog.translation:
Agarraos a las lianas y entrad
aquí!

dialog.english: Okay! ...gh!
Is this gonna hold?

It'll be fine, hurry! We're in a
bit of a tight situation here!
dialog.translation:
Irá bien, daos prisa! Aquí
estamos en un buen aprieto!

dialog.english: O-okay ...ughh!

Whew, we got everyone in. I'm
tired...
dialog.translation:
Uf, ya entramos todos.
Estoy agotado...

dialog.english:
So this is how we do it!
All right, let's head in!
dialog.translation:
Así que es así como se hace!
Venga, entremos!

dialog.english: Yeah!
This is a huge castle...

Yeah, and there might be some
traps around here. Be careful.
dialog.translation:
Sí, y puede que haya trampas
por aquí. Tened cuidado.

dialog.english: All right, I'll go check it out!
dialog.translation: Vale, voy a echar un vistazo!

dialog.english: You go first, Matt.
All right, I'll go check it out!
dialog.translation: Vale, voy a echar un vistazo!

dialog.english: No, I'll go!
Matt...

Tai, if you take the lead,
we'll all get caught in some trap.
dialog.translation:
Tai, si tú vas delante,
caeremos todos en alguna trampa.

dialog.english: Ahahaha!

Don't you start laughing too,
Agumon!
dialog.translation:
No te rías tú también,
Agumon!

dialog.english: You go first, Matt.

What?! Matt, are you okay with
this?
dialog.translation:
Qué?! Matt, te parece bien
esto?

dialog.english:
Matt will do a better job of
being careful around Vamdemon's
minions.
dialog.translation:
Matt se le da mejor tener
cuidado con los secuaces de
Myotismon.

dialog.english:
We're all good and bad at
different things. Tai knows his
strengths and weaknesses, right?
dialog.translation:
Todos somos buenos y malos en
cosas distintas. Tai conoce sus
puntos fuertes y débiles, no?

dialog.english:
See, even I can be more of an
adult sometimes!
dialog.translation:
Ves? Hasta yo puedo ser más
maduro a veces!

dialog.english: Hm? What's this?
Is it safe to approach?

It seems like it transfers you to
another space, like a warp point.
dialog.translation:
Parece que te transporta a otro
espacio, como un teletransporte.

dialog.english:
I don't think it's dangerous per
se, but if we use it carelessly,
we may get lost.
dialog.translation:
No creo que sea peligroso en
sí, pero si lo usamos sin
cuidado, podríamos perdernos.

dialog.english: I guess we'll have to be careful.
There ought to be a map.

I guess we'll have to be careful
about going forward.
dialog.translation:
Supongo que tendremos que ir
con cuidado al avanzar.

dialog.english:
Yes, we need to remember the
locations of the warp entry and
exit points.
dialog.translation:
Sí, debemos recordar las
entradas y salidas de los
teletransportes.

dialog.english:
There ought to be a map with
proper directions.
dialog.translation:
Debería haber un mapa con
las indicaciones.

dialog.english:
No, it's probably a puzzle to keep
out thieves, so we'll have to
memorize all of the directions.
dialog.translation:
No, seguro que es un acertijo
para ahuyentar ladrones, así
que habrá que memorizarlo todo.

dialog.english:
So we've got no choice but to keep
going, right?
dialog.translation:
Así que no nos queda más que
seguir adelante, no?

dialog.english: It seems so.

This place is considerably
strange. The space here is
distorted and twisted.
dialog.translation:
Este lugar es muy extraño.
El espacio aquí está
distorsionado y retorcido.

dialog.english:
This world's weird enough, it
doesn't need this on top of it!
dialog.translation:
Este mundo ya es raro de por
sí, no necesitaba esto además!

dialog.english:
There's something special about 
this place. Is it because 
Vamdemon's power is stronger here?
dialog.translation:
Este lugar tiene algo especial.
Será porque el poder de
Myotismon es más fuerte aquí?

dialog.english:
Don't say things like that. It's
too scary!
dialog.translation:
No digas esas cosas. Da
demasiado miedo!

dialog.english: Anyway, let's keep going!
The time is nigh! We shall depart!
Yes!
Yes!

Our objective is the eighth Chosen
Child! Their corpse will be the
base of my grand ambitions!
dialog.translation:
Nuestro objetivo es el octavo
Niño Elegido! Su cadáver será
la base de mis grandes planes!

dialog.english:
Everything will be consumed by the
power of darkness!
dialog.translation:
Todo será consumido por el
poder de la oscuridad!

dialog.english: Yeah!
Tlon, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius!
Now, we depart!

Waaaaaaaaaaait! We won't let you
do that!
dialog.translation:
Espeeeeeeeera! No dejaremos
que lo hagas!

dialog.english:
So you're finally here...But
you're too late. Observe this
historic moment!
dialog.translation:
Así que al fin llegáis...Pero
es tarde. Observad este
momento histórico!

dialog.english: Don't mess with us!

Unfortunately, I don't have the
time to deal with you.
PicoDevimon!
dialog.translation:
Por desgracia no tengo tiempo
para ocuparme de vosotros.
DemiDevimon!

dialog.english: Yes, sir!
Wanna fight us again?

This won't be like last time!
Nanimon, I'll leave 'em to you!
dialog.translation:
Esta vez será distinto!
Nanimon, te los dejo a ti!

dialog.english:
Got it! You losers are in the way!
Get out, you rascals!
dialog.translation:
Entendido! Estáis en medio,
perdedores! Fuera, granujas!

dialog.english: I surrender, I surrender!
Nanimon! You can't do that!

They say retreating is winning in
its own way! Now, excuse meeeeeee!
dialog.translation:
Dicen que retirarse también es
ganar! Con permisoooooo!

dialog.english: So, what are you gonna do?

S-so sneaky! There's so many of
you here...

Come on, we don't have the time
for this. Let's take him down!
dialog.translation:
Vamos, no tenemos tiempo para
esto. Acabemos con él!

dialog.english:
I-I could say the same for you,
I'll take *you* down!
dialog.translation:
L-lo mismo digo, acabaré con
vosotros!

dialog.english: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
Hurry! The gate's closing!

We don't have time to play around!
Let's go!
dialog.translation:
No hay tiempo para tonterías!
Vamos!

dialog.english: Ugh, what an eyesore!

Another little one. Shoo! Shoo!
Scram! You don't want to get hurt,
do you?
dialog.translation:
Otra cría. Fuera! Fuera!
Largo! No querrás salir
herida, no?

dialog.english: Don't make fun of me! Just watch!
dialog.translation: No te burles de mí! Ya verás!

dialog.english: Cat Kick! Cat Punch!
Aaaaaaaah!
She's stronger than she looks...
dialog.translation:
Es más fuerte de lo que
parece...

dialog.english: It's our turn now!
Let's go!

I'll have to stop you! Devidramon,
go!
Grooooooooooooah!
We did it!
Hurry! Dive into the gate!
Okay, here I go!
I can't let you do that!
Aaaaaaaah!
Gyaaaaaaaah!
Noooooooooooo!
Bye-bye~!
Aaaaah!
No way!
And we were so close...

No! At this rate, the eighth child
is gonna...
dialog.translation:
No! Así, el octavo niño va
a...

dialog.english:
It's too much for us. Everyone,
run!
Come on! Tai...
Tai...
I see. That's a shame.

It's not just a "shame"! At this
point, the eighth child is doomed!
dialog.translation:
No es solo "una pena"! A este
paso, el octavo niño está
perdido!

dialog.english:
Not just that, all those Digimon
are gonna rampage throughout Japan 
and cause all sorts of chaos!
dialog.translation:
Y no solo eso, esos Digimon van
a campar a sus anchas por Japón
y causar todo tipo de caos!

dialog.english: Hm...

Isn't there another way to open
the gate?
dialog.translation:
No hay otra forma de abrir
la puerta?

dialog.english: There's another way, but...
Really?!
Hm, but it's not easy to explain.
dialog.translation:
Hm, pero no es fácil de
explicar.

dialog.english: We don't have time to waste!

All right, then. Why don't you
come to my place?
dialog.translation:
Muy bien, entonces. Por qué no
venís a mi casa?

dialog.english: Your place?
Take a look behind you.
Ah! Over there!

If you follow that light, you'll
arrive at my place.
dialog.translation:
Si seguís esa luz, llegaréis
a mi casa.

dialog.english: Got it!
Then I'll be waiting for you.
